redistribution_classes.commit_safe: Public-domain or permissively licensed material, subject to stated notices and third-party checks.
redistribution_classes.conditional_commit: Open access or open license exists, but specific restrictions need review before repository storage or transformation.
redistribution_classes.private_fixture: Full text may be lawfully acquired for private evaluation but must not be published in the repository.
redistribution_classes.manifest_or_excerpt: Retain retrieval metadata and only a legally reviewed, locatable excerpt if needed.
redistribution_classes.unresolved: Do not freeze until access, edition, provenance, or rights are resolved.
